Rates

Starting prices for Denizen Technologies work. Every project gets a free quote. Not sure what you need? Just ask.

Discord

Discord server setup

from $50

A clean, organized server built around your community.

  • Categories, channels and roles with the right permissions
  • Welcome, rules and verification
  • Up to 3 bots set up (moderation, roles, leveling or music)
  • Basic AutoMod and anti-spam

Mod team setup & training

from $35

Give your mods the tools and the playbook.

  • AutoMod rules, word filters and raid protection
  • Mod roles, private mod channels and a log channel
  • A short mod handbook: when to warn, mute, ban or escalate
  • Optional 1-hour walkthrough with your mods

Monthly server care

$25/month

Keep things running while you focus on your community.

  • Bot updates and replacements when they break
  • Channel and role changes as you grow
  • A monthly permissions check
  • Event and seasonal setups
